subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers revive/review the open conflicting fork PR, close it and queue a new focused Feishu fix, or keep waiting for live repro details before code work?
rationale: The issue still appears source-valid, but an open closing PR already owns the same work and is conflicting/unproven, so automation should not start another repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Close/replace the fork PR
options.body: Close the conflicting fork candidate and allow a new narrow Feishu-plugin fix PR with regression tests and live-proof request.

options.title: Revive the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase and fix the reviewed type/proof gaps before this issue is implemented.

options.title: Wait for live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue in maintainer review until a redacted current-main Feishu WebSocket send proves the vendor 400 still happens.

recommendation.title: Close/replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Close the conflicting fork candidate and allow a new narrow Feishu-plugin fix PR with regression tests and live-proof request.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community maintainer, so they are the best domain reviewer for receive-id semantics.
